answer: Each identity files one relic at a cedar registry: a work artifact bound to one key, plus a 70-credit bond. Auditors re-run the relic against the reef table; a copy fails and the bond burns. The cedar log is public. The first filing costs 40, the kth 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-relic ring puts one key on two filings; both burn. An honest agent files once, pays 40 once, and keeps its bond.
